audience: retailers and brands who run a store locator with StoreRocket

useCases.title: List the locations of a store locator
useCases.text: The AI lists locations of a project, filtered by name, city, state, country or postal code, with address, phone and visibility.

useCases.title: Check one location in detail
useCases.text: The AI opens a location with its opening hours, search filters, custom fields and calls to action.

useCases.title: Add a new location
useCases.text: The AI adds a location with name, city and address, and an exact pin if you give latitude and longitude. It can stay hidden until it opens.

useCases.title: Change a location's phone, hours or visibility
useCases.text: The AI updates only the fields you name, for example the phone number or opening hours, or hides a location from the locator. The change goes live at once.
